task: Open a local speech studio and turn text into audio

x-display.title: Open a local speech studio
x-display.summary: Turn text into speech in your browser, with a local speech API for other tools too.
x-display.description: Choose the studio when you want to work with speech through a browser interface. The same installation can also serve compatible apps through its speech API. For a single text-file-to-WAV task, the Kokoro speech recipe offers that narrower workflow.

packaging_note: Uses the official CPU image for this release. Sample speech is independently transcribed.

access.why: The local web interface is served from a standard container network; requests use the local TTS model.

known_issues: CPU synthesis takes longer on long passages. First start downloads a model-bearing image.
licence: Apache-2.0 (Kokoro-FastAPI and Kokoro-82M); retains upstream notices.
